arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse
from datetime import datetime

tz60 = parse.FixedTzOffset(60, '+01:00')
print('tz60._name:', tz60._name)
print('tz60._offset:', tz60._offset)

# Test parsing +0100
r = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b')
print('Parsed result:', r.fixed[0])
print('tzinfo:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo)
print('tzinfo._name:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo._name)
print('Equal?', r.fixed[0].tzinfo == tz60)

# Let me trace the parsing manually
tz_str = '+0100'
sign = tz_str[0]
print('sign:', sign)
print('len(tz_str):', len(tz_str))
if ':' in tz_str:
    print('Has colon')
elif len(tz_str) == 4:
    tzh, tzm = tz_str[1], tz_str[2:4]
    print('tzh:', tzh, 'tzm:', tzm)
"
